messages:
Maria P: Quick follow-up from PM — RW-508 postmortem remediation. We have 5 action items that need owners + Jira links. Can folks claim by EOD Wed?
Alex K: I can take 'Improve cache eviction heuristic' — will create a JIRA ticket (RW-2345) by EOD and add acceptance criteria.
Kevin L: I'll own 'Alert tuning + oncall playbook' — creating RW-2346 now, target next Tue for initial draft. Need to coordinate with eng-sre.
Sara O: I'll pick up 'Capacity headroom test harness' — RW-2347, ETA ~2w, will add test plan and run schedule.
Maria P: Draft RACI: R = Executors (Alex / Kevin / Sara), A = Maria P (PM), C = EngSRE + Product, I = Execs / CS. Please confirm or suggest edits.
Alex K: Ack. Acceptance criteria I'll add to RW-2345: reproducible load test, quantified SLA improvement, docs updated with mitigation steps.
Kevin L: Also: handoff checklist to oncall before closure. @incident-bot can you add a recurring reminder for remediation sync? :calendar: 
incident-bot: Reminder set — weekly remediation sync Wednesdays 10:00am PT in #postmortems.
Sara O: Noted. I'll schedule a walkthrough with oncall and attach the runbook before marking RW-2347 done.
Maria P: I'll link these to the PM epic RW-2400. Owners — paste the Jira link in this thread when created so I can cross-reference the remediation tracker.
Alex K: RW-2345: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RW-2345 — RACI and ACs added to ticket description.
Kevin L: RW-2346: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RW-2346 — playbook draft uploaded, tagged eng-sre for review.
Sara O: RW-2347: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RW-2347 — test harness outline attached, scheduling notes added.
Maria P: One more item — note on recurring pattern: this is the 3rd cache-related incident in ~6 months. Ops/infra needs to propose a longer-term mitigation. Kevin, can you include a post-change validation step and a proposal in your ticket?
Kevin L: Will do. Adding validation step to RW-2345 & RW-2346 and proposing a weekly synthetic test slot against Dedicated pools to detect regressions early.
Alex K: I'll coordinate with runtime team on quantization + eviction interaction — will CC runtime team in RW-2345.
Maria P: Closing loop: owners to link tickets and set target completion dates by EOD Fri. We'll review progress in Monday's remediation sync. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
